Auction of 1-Year Notes
On May 14 the Treasury announced that it would auction $6,000 million of 2-year notes to refund $2,824 million of notes maturing May 31, 1980, and to raise $1,176 million new cash. On May 21 the Treasury announced that it would auction $3,000 million of 5-year 2-1/2-month notes to raise new cash. 52-Week Bills
On May 15 tenders were invited for approximately $4,000 million of 359-day Treasury bills to be dated May 27, 1981 and to mature May 21, 1981. On May 23 tenders were invited for approximately $2,700 million of 19-day Treasury bills to be issued May 29, 1980, and to mature June 17, 1980. The issue was to raise new cash.
